title: Harvesting Safety Assessment
description: Free Harvesting Safety Assessment template for agriculture you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers hazards and controls, before the shift, approval & sign-off.

Hazards And Controls

HazardWho / what is at riskExisting controlsLSRiskAdditional controls / owner
Combine / harvester entangleme nt and fireOperatorsGuards, clean chaff build-up, fire extin guisher, lock-out for blockages
Heat stress and dehydratio nAll workersWater, shade, rest breaks, work-hour planning
Manual handling and repetitive workPickersRotation, aids, correct techniques
Sharp tools and cutsPickersGloves, safe storage, training
Vehicle and trailer movements in fieldsWorkersTraffic plan, spotter, visibility
Pesticide residues and re- entryWorkersRespect re-entry intervals, signs, PPE
Insect, snake and animal bitesWorkersAwareness, boots, first aid

Risk Rating Guide (L = Likelihood 1-5, S = Severity 1-5, Risk = L X S)

1. 1-4 Low: manage by routine procedures.

2. 5-9 Medium: add controls where reasonably practicable and monitor.

3. 10-16 High: do not start or continue until controls reduce the risk; senior approval

needed.

4. 17-25 Extreme: stop work; redesign or eliminate the hazard.

Before The Shift

☐ Weather forecast checked; heat plan ready

☐ Equipment inspected and guards fitted

☐ First aid kit and communication available in the field

☐ Workers briefed on hazards, emergency contact and meeting point
